# Scaling_Law_Breakdown

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The phenomenon where standard power-law scaling of model performance with size fails near a phase transition, requiring new scaling descriptors. Guides the design of compact in-network neuromorphic architectures that avoid wasteful scaling and instead target critical regimes.
